lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cu4Ga2S4 (reduced formula Cu2GaS2) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 10 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu and Ga centers each coordinated by four S neighbors, while each S center has six geometric neighbors (two Cu, two Ga, and two S). The resulting periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 10 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between S-centered six-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Cu- and Ga-centered four-vertex polyhedra.
